behavior.arguments: rdi = output pointer, rsi = string pointer, rdx = length
behavior.branch_order: length == 9 is tested first, then length == 5, then the tag-2 fall-through; a length match with a byte mismatch falls through to tag 2
behavior.keyword_decoding: 0x75706e69 little-endian is "inpu", byte 4 xor 0x74 ('t') gives "input"; 0x696d696c5f736167 little-endian is "gas_limi", byte 8 xor 0x74 ('t') gives "gas_limit"
behavior.output_shape: byte 0 of output is always 9, byte 1 is the tag, then ret; rax returns the output pointer unchanged
behavior.tag_0: length == 5 and first 4 bytes xor 0x75706e69 ("inpu", little-endian) is 0 and byte 4 xor 0x74 ('t') is 0, i.e. the string is exactly "input"
behavior.tag_1: length == 9 and first 8 bytes xor 0x696d696c5f736167 ("gas_limi", little-endian) is 0 and byte 8 xor 0x74 ('t') is 0, i.e. the string is exactly "gas_limit"
behavior.tag_2: every other input (including length 5 that is not "input" and length 9 that is not "gas_limit")

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase
